Immediate review should focus on the verified Bridge Mixed work-02 stroke-rate deviation, the verified Atlas Men recovery-02 duration deviation, the missing 4x Mixed B workout source, and unresolved athlete/session context. Keep water and indoor evidence separate, and do not attribute Atlas Men 4x pace differences to the crew without resolving the 7.8 m/s tail-cross wind and other session context.

limitations: This is a within-workout observed difference; the evidence does not establish why the time changed.
